name: 100 - API - Manage Outbound Message Dead Letters - Corrected V2

nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Dead Letter Management

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS action,
        NULLIF($2::TEXT, '') AS clinic_name,
        NULLIF($3::BIGINT, 0) AS dead_letter_id,
        NULLIF($4::BIGINT, 0) AS outbound_message_id,
        $5::TEXT AS resolved_filter,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS actor_name,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS resolution_note,
        $8::BOOLEAN AS reset_attempts,
        $9::INTEGER AS result_limit
),

scope AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,
        clinic.id AS clinic_id
    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
),

target_dead_letter AS (
    SELECT
        dead_letter.*,
        message.clinic_id,
        message.status AS message_status,
        message.channel,
        message.purpose,
        message.recipient,
        message.attempt_count,
        message.max_attempts,
        message.last_error_code,
        message.last_error_message
    FROM outbound_message_dead_letters dead_letter
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           dead_letter.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE (
            (
                scope_row.dead_letter_id IS NOT NULL
                AND dead_letter.id =
                    scope_row.dead_letter_id
            )
            OR (
                scope_row.dead_letter_id IS NULL
                AND scope_row.outbound_message_id IS NOT NULL
                AND dead_letter.outbound_message_id =
                    scope_row.outbound_message_id
            )
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR message.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    ORDER BY dead_letter.id
    LIMIT 1
),

requeued_message AS (
    UPDATE outbound_messages message
    SET
        status = 'queued',
        attempt_count = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.reset_attempts = TRUE
                THEN 0
            ELSE message.attempt_count
        END,
        next_attempt_at = NOW(),
        failed_at = NULL,
        last_error_code = NULL,
        last_error_message = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM scope scope_row
    WHERE scope_row.action = 'requeue'
      AND message.id = (
            SELECT outbound_message_id
            FROM target_dead_letter
          )
    RETURNING message.*
),

cancelled_message AS (
    UPDATE outbound_messages message
    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM scope scope_row
    WHERE scope_row.action = 'cancel'
      AND message.id = (
            SELECT outbound_message_id
            FROM target_dead_letter
          )
    RETURNING message.*
),

updated_dead_letter AS (
    UPDATE outbound_message_dead_letters dead_letter
    SET
        resolved = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'requeue',
                'resolve',
                'cancel'
            )
                THEN TRUE
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN FALSE
            ELSE dead_letter.resolved
        END,

        resolved_by = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'requeue',
                'resolve',
                'cancel'
            )
                THEN scope_row.actor_name
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE dead_letter.resolved_by
        END,

        resolution_note = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'requeue'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    scope_row.resolution_note,
                    'Message requeued for another delivery attempt.'
                )
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'resolve',
                'cancel'
            )
                THEN scope_row.resolution_note
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE dead_letter.resolution_note
        END,

        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN scope_row.action IN (
                'requeue',
                'resolve',
                'cancel'
            )
                THEN NOW()
            WHEN scope_row.action = 'reopen'
                THEN NULL
            ELSE dead_letter.resolved_at
        END

    FROM scope scope_row
    WHERE dead_letter.id = (
            SELECT id
            FROM target_dead_letter
          )
      AND scope_row.action IN (
            'requeue',
            'resolve',
            'cancel',
            'reopen'
          )
    RETURNING dead_letter.*
),

reopened_message AS (
    UPDATE outbound_messages message
    SET
        status = 'dead_letter',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM scope scope_row
    WHERE scope_row.action = 'reopen'
      AND message.id = (
            SELECT outbound_message_id
            FROM target_dead_letter
          )
    RETURNING message.*
),

list_rows AS (
    SELECT
        dead_letter.id,
        dead_letter.outbound_message_id,
        message.clinic_id,
        message.channel,
        message.purpose,
        message.recipient,
        message.status AS message_status,
        message.attempt_count,
        message.max_attempts,
        dead_letter.final_error_code,
        dead_letter.final_error_message,
        dead_letter.resolved,
        dead_letter.resolved_by,
        dead_letter.resolution_note,
        dead_letter.resolved_at,
        dead_letter.created_at
    FROM outbound_message_dead_letters dead_letter
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           dead_letter.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE scope_row.action = 'list'
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR message.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.resolved_filter = 'all'
            OR (
                scope_row.resolved_filter = 'resolved'
                AND dead_letter.resolved = TRUE
            )
            OR (
                scope_row.resolved_filter = 'unresolved'
                AND dead_letter.resolved = FALSE
            )
          )
    ORDER BY dead_letter.created_at DESC
    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
),

selected_row AS (
    SELECT TO_JSONB(target_dead_letter) AS value
    FROM target_dead_letter
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE request.action = 'get'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'dead_letter',
            TO_JSONB(updated_dead_letter),
        'requeued_message',
            (
                SELECT TO_JSONB(requeued_message)
                FROM requeued_message
            ),
        'cancelled_message',
            (
                SELECT TO_JSONB(cancelled_message)
                FROM cancelled_message
            ),
        'reopened_message',
            (
                SELECT TO_JSONB(reopened_message)
                FROM reopened_message
            )
    )
    FROM updated_dead_letter
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scope
            WHERE clinic_id IS NOT NULL
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.action IN (
            'get',
            'requeue',
            'resolve',
            'cancel',
            'reopen'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_dead_letter
         )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scope
            WHERE clinic_id IS NOT NULL
         )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN request.action IN (
            'get',
            'requeue',
            'resolve',
            'cancel',
            'reopen'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_dead_letter
         )
            THEN 'dead_letter_not_found'

        WHEN request.action = 'requeue'
            THEN 'dead_letter_message_requeued'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve'
            THEN 'dead_letter_resolved'

        WHEN request.action = 'cancel'
            THEN 'dead_letter_message_cancelled'

        WHEN request.action = 'reopen'
            THEN 'dead_letter_reopened'

        WHEN request.action = 'get'
            THEN 'dead_letter_loaded'

        ELSE 'dead_letters_listed'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT value
        FROM selected_row
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS dead_letter,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(list_rows)
            )
            FROM list_rows
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS dead_letters,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM list_rows
        ),
        0
    ) AS dead_letter_count

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{success:false,result:'invalid_request',message:'اطلاعات مدیریت Dead Letter نامعتبر است.',errors:$json.errors||[]}}];

parameters.content:
## مدیریت Dead Letter

اقدام‌ها:
- list
- get
- requeue
- resolve
- cancel
- reopen

Requeue پیام را به صف برمی‌گرداند و Dead Letter را Resolve می‌کند.

اصلاح V2:
- Clinic Not Found دیگر Dead Letterهای همه کلینیک‌ها را نمایش نمی‌دهد.
- Clinic Isolation برای dead_letter_id و outbound_message_id اعمال می‌شود.
- اولویت OR/AND در target_dead_letter اصلاح شده است.
